editorial:
If you want a loud, silly action ride, this one delivers plenty of explosions and buddy-comedy energy. You follow two tough soldiers who must protect a group of civilians while crossing a dangerous war zone. The story is simple, but the movie keeps moving with car chases, gunfights, and big set pieces. Jackie Chan and John Cena bring different styles, so their banter gives the action a lighter feel. It is not serious or deep, but it knows exactly what it is: a fun popcorn movie with lots of noise and movement.

The action is the main attraction, with big stunts, vehicle scenes, and plenty of chaos. The comedy lands sometimes, though some jokes feel forced. Pacing stays fast, so you rarely get bored, but the plot is thin and the villains are forgettable. If you enjoy buddy action movies, you will have a good time.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the soldiers and civilians reach safety after a huge last battle. The main villain is defeated during the chaos, and the escort mission ends successfully. The twist is that one trusted ally was working against them, but the heroes figure it out in time. The movie closes with the soldiers sharing a joke, showing their bond survived the danger.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves loud buddy action movies and big stunts.
